verdict.rationale: FireHydrant, an incident-management SaaS platform, publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub org (firehydrant/firehydrant-mcp), and a probe confirms the documented repo, so an agent can connect through a first-party server. The evidence only establishes that the server exists, without details on what it can do or how to connect. Missing for 10: documentation of exposed tools/capabilities, setup/auth and transport details, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
